sections.theory:
Effects of doping and alcohol on players

Temporarily fatigue is not felt; rather performance increases immediately.

They affect the physical system of players.

They create mental anxiety, because of which attention is not concentrated.

They create breathing troubles, because of which the player gets tired in a few minutes and starts to get out of breath.

They create a shortage in the blood, which affects the health of players.

The attitude of players becomes negative, which affects performance.

Method of prevention and awareness campaign

Players should be made aware of its negative effects.

Players should be made acquainted with its effects on health and performance.

In free time players should be given alternative activities.

Players should be made to practise increasing performance and achieving targets.

Seminars should be arranged on alcohol and doping.

A walk should be organised to avoid the harmful effects of alcohol and doping.

Some event should be organised against the negative effects of alcohol.

A publicity campaign should be run on the harmful effects of alcohol.

Through print and electronic media the harmful effects of alcohol should be highlighted.

sections.content:
Effects of doping and alcohol on players

Temporarily fatigue is not felt; rather performance increases immediately.

They affect the physical system of players.

They create mental anxiety, because of which attention is not concentrated.

They create breathing troubles, because of which the player gets tired in a few minutes and starts to get out of breath.

They create a shortage in the blood, which affects the health of players.

The attitude of players becomes negative, which affects performance.

Method of prevention and awareness campaign

Players should be made aware of its negative effects.

Players should be made acquainted with its effects on health and performance.

In free time players should be given alternative activities.

Players should be made to practise increasing performance and achieving targets.

Seminars should be arranged on alcohol and doping.

A walk should be organised to avoid the harmful effects of alcohol and doping.

Some event should be organised against the negative effects of alcohol.

A publicity campaign should be run on the harmful effects of alcohol.

Through print and electronic media the harmful effects of alcohol should be highlighted.
